reality_delta: The RSP-16 portability probe is now fixture-only and isolated in runtime/core/cap_revival_portability.py, invoked through temporary HOME/CAP_HOME. Public RSP evidence uses redacted configured_path placeholders and does not contain private body or real title text. The claim is scoped to RSP-16 only and excludes real migration/copy/push.
main_concern: The normal soul-loader still reads the real private identity source and writes public evidence, but the regenerated public soul evidence files (latest-load.json / load-ledger.jsonl) are not included in the review bundle. Without them I cannot independently confirm that real absolute paths and real title text were actually redacted, or that only the allowed fields (sha256, counts, title_present) appear. The prior concern is resolved for the RSP-16 fixture check, but the broader public-evidence redaction claim remains unverified.
top_risks: The fixture-only RSP-16 check validates loader logic but cannot prove that real cross-machine or multi-user migration works; a permission/path bug visible only with real $CAP_HOME could be missed.
Public soul evidence still records sha256 of the private identity body, which can leak confirmation of guessed content; the contract allows it, but no rotation/salt is mentioned.
The leak-scan coverage in the provided RSP evidence is truncated and only shows one scanned temp path; I cannot confirm the public repo-wide scan for fixture strings and real private absolute paths.
missing_evidence: assets/evidence/soul/latest-load.json and assets/evidence/soul/load-ledger.jsonl after regeneration, to verify normal-loader redaction of real absolute path and real title text.
The rg scan receipt/output for $CAP_HOME/identity.md and fixture sentinel strings across RedCap public docs/contracts/evidence.
The complete public_text_scan / fixture_evidence_leak_scan sections of assets/evidence/rsp/rsp-16-cap-revival-portability.json (truncated in bundle).
minimum_fix: Add the regenerated soul evidence files and the rg scan receipt to the review evidence. If they confirm no real private path/title/body appears, the concern is cleared. Also expand the RSP evidence leak-scan detail to show the full set of scanned public paths and fixture strings.

anti_loop_signal.reason: The claim explicitly scopes RSP-16, excludes migration/copy/full revival, and the portability check is fixture-only — all healthy anti-loop signals. The gap is that the narrative of 'soul evidence now redacted' is presented without showing the redacted files.

user_intent_alignment: The implementation aligns with the public/private separation intent and the bounded verification intent, but only partially with the real cross-machine migration intent because actual private identity migration is deferred to Norven's human decision and only loader behavior is tested with synthetic fixtures.
